notes.title: Blockscape 2024 update 6 (Slope Tool Preview)
notes.notes:
Hi!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4471392/151cbab53d0469ab4129133c45bb0aba172abcc0.jpg[/img]

Highlights in this update:

[list]
[*][b]Slope tool[/b]
The tool to replace all slope block tools. It doesn't cover all the cases (like double convex/concave slopes) yet but it works good enough for you to try it out. I built the pirate ship in the picture above using only the slope tool and the beam tool for all slopes. 
[*][b]Beam tool[/b]
Similar to the the Slope tool but it doesn't fill space.
[*][b]Eye dropper ([ALT] + [RMB])[/b]
Material replace tool + eye dropper now selects material only
Paint tool + eye dropper now selects paint color only
Material cover tool + eye dropper now selects material only. 
Fixed material set by eye dropper tool sometimes shows wrong material.
Eye dropper tool will now work on both blocks and smooth materials. If used on smooth materials mblock will be selected as tool. 
[*][b]Adaptive modular building parts[/b]
Fixed adaptive modular building parts (auto roofs) update when deleting neighbor parts
Fixed material selection of many modular building parts
Fixed placement position of wall modular building parts.
[*][b]Other[/b]
Fixed placement position of doors.
[/list]

Have fun!
/Jens

notes.title: Blockscape 2024 update 4

[h2]Highlights in this update:[/h2]

Improved smoke and debris/water spalsh rendering. It now looks like it has a bit more volume. 
More fixes and improvements to water reflections.
Lowered the bloom threshold a tiny bit.
New hay texture maps. 

[*][b]Gameplay logic[/b]
Added "You are starving!" warning when you are starving. 
Changed so that you don't heal if you are starving.

Fixed Add/delete single plant random crash.

Jens

notes.title: Blockscape 2024 Update 3
notes.notes:
Hi!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4471392/c8ceec887b715011fd1e8936dc0bf1b534a75fb4.png[/img]

Highlights in this update:

[list]
[*]New sleeping logic 
First you need a bed (same as before). You can't sleep if you have unprotected items. Sleeping will now progress time. One second of sleep equals one hour of game time. Sleeping will show a small animation of the sun and moon to give you an idea of how long you slept and what time of day it is. Health regeneration is faster when you sleep and is now much slower when you are awake. Check it out and tell me what you think. 
[*]Random big hole in terrain finally fixed
This was a tricky one to fix. To keep the memory usage down I do real time mesh optimization in the background on as many cores that is available in the machine. The error happened because of a rare sync error between all the threads. 
[*]Fixed many water reflection errors
[/list]

Have fun!
/Jens

[list]
[*]Fixed large scale ambient occlusion in closed/indoor environments. It was a bit too dark in the previous version.

[/list]



/Jens

notes.title: Some info about the next update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4471392/0ae6c664a15f44aeb79b3a49a6a93c3a6307c3cb.jpg[/img]

Hi!

Time flies. I'm working really hard here to give you the next update and sometimes some things just takes a lot of time. Here is what to expect in the next update:

[list]
[*][b]Procedural building are now made of modular building parts. [/b]
I decided to convert all the procedural buildings so that they are made of the new modular building parts. This will make it much easier to modify existing buildings and it will also give you an idea of how to use the modular building parts.  
[*][b]Fixed all interpolation and material transition errors between world chunks. [/b]
This was really hard to fix but the result is really good. I had to rework some of the more advanced parts of the engine to have all the information available near the borders. When I got it working it was way to slow so I had to figure out ways to optimize it which took me a lot of time. 
[*][b]Many new modular building parts. [/b]
[*][b]You can now split modular building parts into blocks. [/b]
[/list]

This will be the final preview before a proper v14 release.  

best regards
Jens

notes.title: The autumn release is here! (build 1468021)
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Follow me on https://twitter.com/JensBlomquist for latest news. 

This release is really massive :)

The biggest change is all the logic I have added to the mblock tool to make building and digging easier and more fun. Blocks will now glue, smooth and collapse depending on the material type. Building roofs is super simple and blocks of rock material will automatically take the shape of rocks no matter what you do.

The new sound system and all the new sounds effects takes the game to a new level. 

The bomb is fun. :)

Two defense towers are available in "just build" mode. Also fun. :)

Highlights:

- Block physics for loose materials. 
- Easy roof build mode using the mblock (use [F8] to change slope)
- Easy spruce build mode using the mblock (use [F8] to change slope)- 
- Complete sound effects overhaul.
- All sounds now have correct pan position and volume based on location.
- More and better destruction particles.
- View distance setting. 
- Loads of optimizations.
- World encoded rock structure. 
- Bombs! :)
- First versions of defense towers. Also first version of dynamic (freely movable) block models.


Full list of features and fixes:

notes.title: The autumn release is here! (build 1468021)
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Follow me on https://twitter.com/JensBlomquist for latest news. 

This release is really massive :)

The biggest change is all the logic I have added to the mblock tool to make building and digging easier and more fun. Blocks will now glue, smooth and collapse depending on the material type. Building roofs is super simple and blocks of rock material will automatically take the shape of rocks no matter what you do.

The new sound system and all the new sounds effects takes the game to a new level. 

The bomb is fun. :)

Two defense towers are available in "just build" mode. Also fun. :)

Highlights:

- Block physics for loose materials. 
- Easy roof build mode using the mblock (use [F8] to change slope)
- Easy spruce build mode using the mblock (use [F8] to change slope)- 
- Complete sound effects overhaul.
- All sounds now have correct pan position and volume based on location.
- More and better destruction particles.
- View distance setting. 
- Loads of optimizations.
- World encoded rock structure. 
- Bombs! :)
- First versions of defense towers. Also first version of dynamic (freely movable) block models.
